Additional Application Information
Undergraduate Applications
Students wishing to attend UCCS, either online or on campus, after graduating from high school and who have not taken college courses after high school are considered first-year students.
Please visit the Admissions Details page for additional information about the first-year student application process.
Students applying for ASCENT and TREP will also use this application.
Returning UCCS Students
Those who have previously attended UCCS as a degree-seeking student, either online or on campus, and who would like to be readmitted are considered Returning UCCS Students.
If you previously attended as a non-degree seeking student you will need to fill out an undergraduate application.
Transfer Students
Students who have graduated high school or have earned a high school equivalency and have 24+ college credit hours are considered transfer students.
Transfer students interested in online or on-campus programs can use the Undergraduate Student Application.
Please visit the Admissions Details page to learn more about the application process.
Online Applications
Need straight facts fast? Clawdia knows the details. Call our AI Admissions Recruiter for expert guidance at (719) 255-3439.
International Students
Students interested in undergraduate programs who are not residents of a U.S. territory are considered international students.
Please visit the Admissions Details page to learn more about the international student application process.
Non-degree Seeking Students
Students who have not already earned a bachelor's degree and would like to take courses, either online or on campus, but do not wish to complete a degree are considered undergraduate non-degree seeking students and select the undergraduate application.
Students who have earned a bachelor's degree and would like to take undergraduate or graduate courses, either online or on campus, but do not wish to complete a degree are considered graduate non-degree seeking students and select the graduate application.
Please visit the Admissions Details page to learn more about the non-degree seeking student application process.
Concurrent and Dual Enrollment
Through special partnerships and agreements with school districts, students can enroll at UCCS while still in high school through Concurrent and dual enrollment opportunities.
Please visit the Admissions Details page to learn more about the student application process.
Graduate Application
Individuals who have completed a Bachelor's Degree and are interested in pursuing further education at UCCS, either online or on campus, are considered graduate students.
This application is for the following students interested in graduate programs:
Degree-seeking students
Non-degree seeking students
International students
To learn more about the graduate student application process, please visit the Admissions Details page.
Academic Outreach Application
The Academic Outreach application is for the following individuals:
K-12 students interested in Middle or High School programs
Professionals interested in continuous learning or career development
Life-long learners
To learn more about Academic Outreach programs at UCCS, please visit the Academic Outreach program page.
The Common App
In addition to the UCCS-specific application, Freshman and Transfer students may apply to UCCS through the Common App.
